name: convert_await_message_sensor
description: Migrate an Apache Airflow AwaitMessageSensor (apache-airflow-providers-apache-kafka) to a Databricks Lakeflow KafkaMessageSensor python_operator_task. Returns a task dict ready to drop under resources.jobs.<job>.tasks in a Databricks Asset Bundle. Use when converting an existing Airflow Kafka workflow to run on Databricks Jobs.

task_id.description: The Airflow task_id; becomes the bundle task_key.

topics.description: The Airflow sensor's topics. The first entry is used (KafkaMessageSensor watches one topic).

match_value_contains.description: Substring the message body must contain to complete, i.e. the intent of the Airflow apply_function. Leave empty to complete on any message received on the topic.

poll_interval.description: Airflow poll_interval in seconds; becomes defer_seconds (compute released between polls).

timeout_seconds.description: Optional hard wall-clock ceiling across deferrals.

group_id.description: Kafka consumer group. Defaults to a per-run group so each job run gets a clean watch.
